title: Sliding Window Max-Min Difference
statement: Given an array of N positive integers and a window size K, slide the window across the array from left to right. For each window of size K, compute max(window) - min(window) and print the results separated by spaces.
input_format: First line: N K. Second line: N positive integers.
output_format: Print N - K + 1 space-separated integers representing the difference for each window.
